notes: IS only: close < cut. No OOS row was built or simulated.
Tape is about two days: hour-of-day blocks have few independent samples, so tod_vol results are weak evidence.
shift_min None and div_min None mean off (the brief's -1 for shift).
Numeric genes step +-1 on the grid; blocks resample; entry, barrier_exit resample.
A genome already evaluated reuses its IS summary; every child is still logged.
Quotes snap to the $0.001 tick; engine ticks with spot <= 0 are dropped before the divergence lookup (they fall back to the last valid tick within 1.5s).
The cost band is applied in the mask before pick(), as in f2_structural.frozen_mask, so out-of-band triggers do not use up the cooldown; run_trade still enforces it.
